results.summary: The gold balance starts at 0 and the status text shows 'Gold: %d'. A gold purse at the barracks node is spawned in BeginPlay; E on it adds PurseGold (100) once, sets bPurseTaken and destroys the purse, so a second pickup gives nothing. Read only: the build has never run and the pickup has not been played.

evidence.note: Gold = 0 start, bPurseTaken flag, PurseGold = 100 demo value labelled as the crew's EXPERIMENTAL toll value.

case EDDDemoKind::Purse: if (!bAlt && !bPurseTaken) adds PurseGold, announces it, destroys the purse.
GetStatusLines adds the gold line to the on-screen status.
DrawHUD draws the director's status lines top left.
E reaches the director through Interact(false).
E (EKeys::E) is mapped to InteractAction and bound to Interact.
Node exists and is reachable from town_entrance through plain doors e02, e04, e10, e11.

results.score_reason: GDD Currency: Gold (line 319) and the HUD (lines 395-397) need a gold balance, and the toll in TOLL-02 cannot be paid without it. It is already implemented, so urgency is 0; TOLL-02 depends on it, so unblocks is 2.

results.summary: A bandit boss is spawned at boss_room. E on him at the threatening stage shows bandit_boss_stage_threatening_01 with {toll_amount} filled from toll_gold (100) and a hint to press Q. The name is the literal 'adventurer' in the demo. Read only: the build has never run.

evidence.note: Reads bandit_strings.csv and faction_stages.json, takes TollGold from the threatening stage's toll_gold.
Boss E branch (not paid) shows BossLine of this string, then the 'Press Q' hint.

BeginPlay spawns the Boss interactable at NodeLocation("boss_room").

results.score_reason: GDD Boss and standing (lines 385-387) says the boss starts at threatening and demands a toll, which is the first thing the player meets at the descent. The boss is already in place with its strings loaded, so urgency is 0; TOLL-02 depends on it, so unblocks is 2.

results.summary: Q on the boss pays. With gold >= TollGold it subtracts exactly TollGold, sets bTollPaid and shows bandit_boss_toll_paid_01 with log_toll_paid. With less gold it shows bandit_boss_cannot_pay_01 and takes nothing. Once paid, further Q presses only say 'already paid' and no gold is taken again. No favor value exists to change. Read only: the build has never run and no payment has been played.

evidence.note: Boss Alt branch: already paid check, then Gold >= TollGold subtracts TollGold and sets bTollPaid, else the cannot-pay line.
Shown when Gold < TollGold; no gold change, bTollPaid stays false.
Shown on successful payment, with log_toll_paid.
Boss prompt offers 'Q Pay the toll' only while bTollPaid is false.
Per-run flag, read by the descent (DD-DESC-01).
Q (EKeys::Q, AltAction) is bound to AltInteract, which calls Interact(true) on the focused interactable.
Focus is the nearest interactable with a prompt within InteractRange (280).
Rule text: gold >= toll_locked AND toll_paid_this_visit = 0; favor_delta 0. The code uses a per-run flag rather than a per-visit one, which the scope's 'never charged twice' allows.

results.score_reason: GDD Boss and standing (lines 385-387) and crew rule TOLL-03 make paying the toll the only way past the boss, so this is central to the ending. The payment branches are already in the code, so urgency is 0; DESC-01 depends on it, so unblocks is 2.

results.summary: The descent is spawned at node descent. Before the toll is paid, E says the boss bars the way and the demo continues. After payment, E ends the demo: a YOU WIN message is logged, bDemoOver stops further interaction, pawn input is disabled, and the HUD keeps a win banner up. Read only: the build has never run and the win has not been played.

evidence.note: HandleInteract Descent branch: not paid shows 'bars the way down'; paid sets bDemoOver, adds the win message and calls DisableInput on the pawn.
Win message text; PromptFor returns no prompt once bDemoOver is set.
BeginPlay spawns the Descent interactable at NodeLocation("descent").
Public accessor read by the HUD for the win banner.
DrawHUD draws 'YOU WIN - You went down the descent. The demo is over.' while the demo is over.
GameMode spawns the director if the level has none, so the descent and HUD are reached in DemoLevel.
GlobalDefaultGameMode is DDDemoGameMode.
Node exists; reached from boss_room via e15 (plain door).

results.score_reason: GDD Win (lines 44-45) and Boss Encounter Winning (line 390) say going down the descent ends the demo, so this is the milestone's last step. It is already implemented, so urgency is 0 and nothing depends on it, so unblocks is 0.
